SCAN_NOTE: Scanning takes about 12 seconds. Audio-capable devices are listed first when BlueZ reports their profile.
VOLUME_NOTE: Software is safest initially. Speaker hardware volume may not follow Volumio volume.
CREATE_OUTPUT_NOTE: Available only when device diagnostics confirm BlueALSA. This never installs a competing audio stack or edits MPD directly.
MANUAL_OUTPUT_NOTE: Switching output stops playback. Press Play when the switch completes. Default output returns to the device already selected in Playback Options.
